### `terrainHeightfieldSource(value, { material = true } = {})`

Saved WGSL owns the compact samples. It needs no private texture binding, runtime lookup or generator fallback, so copied/deleted/recreated nodes work.

### `terrainDisplayField(value, bounds = [-18, -3, 18, 51])`

Convert simulation units to display coordinates without inventing geometry.

### `terrainSpatialField(value, { bounds = [-2.275, -.9, 2.275, 3.1], minHeight = 0, maxHeight = .9 } = {})`

A scaled copy of the same measured field grounds all Gaussian scene parts.
